**Life at UiPath**
The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
  
  
To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
  
  
Could that be you?
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer to be part of the Data Fabric platform team —a next-generation distributed data infrastructure that enables seamless data integration, processing, governance and security at scale. As a developer, you will build robust, scalable, and high-performance systems.
  
  
**What You'll Do At UiPath**
We are looking for talented and driven Software Engineer I who excel in creating exceptional user experiences and take pride in delivering highly scalable and maintainable solutions. While frontend expertise is a must, full-stack experience is highly preferred (but not mandatory). At UiPath, we are tackling exciting challenges, including those at the intersection of AI and intelligent agents, so if you're eager to be part of the forefront of innovation, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  

* Passion for Building Scalable Solutions: Demonstrated ability to produce robust, well-tested, high-quality code while adhering to best practices in software development.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: Proactively focus on enhancing customer experience and delivering impactful solutions. Strong accountability and ownership over the work you produce and the problems you solve.
* Drive towards AI Innovation: Passionate about contributing to cutting-edge solutions involving AI-driven systems and intelligent agents, helping redefine automation and user interfaces.
* Innovative Thinking: Stay ahead of the curve with emerging trends, especially in AI and intelligent agent technologies, and leverage them to create exceptional product experiences.
* Team Collaboration: Work well in agile teams, contribute towards team alignment, and foster a collaborative environment where ideas and knowledge are freely exchanged.
* Bias for Action & Adaptability: Exhibit a proactive, can-do attitude with an entrepreneurial mindset. Comfortable navigating dynamic environments and embracing ambiguity when solving complex business problems.
* Effective Communication Skills: Clearly articulate technical ideas, design decisions, and solutions to diverse audiences in both written and verbal formats while driving consensus.

**What you'll bring to the team**

* 1–2 years of hands-on experience as a software developer (internships and project work count).
* Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar. Experience using AI models or APIs to build real software — not just academic or research exposure.
* Comfortable working with APIs, backend services, and cloud infrastructure. A builder’s mindset: you like creating usable things, fast.
* Curiosity about how AI is reshaping software development and user experiences.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
  
  
Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.
  
  
We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

jobs.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

**Overview:**
We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our Database Engineering organization. This team develops and maintains a suite of database performance monitoring and related applications that help database professionals improve performance and productivity across multiple database platforms.

This role is a good fit for an engineer who enjoys building reliable, secure, and performant enterprise software, working across application layers, and solving customer problems with a collaborative team. You will contribute to product development from understanding requirements through implementation, testing, and delivery, while continuing to grow your technical skills across our products and platforms.

You will help develop and enhance our Database Performance Analyzer solutions, working with experienced engineers, product managers, and other partners to deliver useful capabilities for customers.

**Responsibilities:**
- Implement, test, and maintain product features across the application stack, with guidance from senior engineers when needed.
  
- Translate product requirements and technical designs into clear, maintainable code and contribute to design discussions for your areas of work.
  
- Apply engineering quality practices, including unit and integration testing, thoughtful coding patterns, and appropriate observability.
  
- Investigate and resolve software defects, participate in code reviews, and help improve the reliability and performance of the product.
  
- Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, peers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver customer-focused solutions.
  
- Collaborate with teammates across products and platforms, share knowledge, and take increasing ownership of features from implementation through release.
  
- Use AI agents and AI-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully to support software development, while reviewing and validating generated work for correctness, security, and quality.
  
- Participate in spec-driven development by helping turn requirements into clear specifications, using those specifications to guide implementation and tests, and updating them as solutions evolve.

**Qualifications:**
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field and 3+ years of software development experience, or a Master’s degree and 2+ years of experience, or equivalent practical experience.
  
• Experience developing software with Java 11+ and the Spring Framework.
  
**Working knowledge of**

* JavaScript
* jQuery
* Angular (Nova Framework)
* SQL, and the Tomcat Application Server.

• Ability to contribute to features across frontend and backend layers, with support from the team as appropriate.
  
• Familiarity with software development fundamentals, including debugging, testing, code review, and source control.
  
• Exposure to DevOps practices and continuous integration/deployment is a plus.
  
• Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agents in software development is preferred; curiosity and willingness to learn are important.
  
• Familiarity with spec-driven development—or experience working from written requirements, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria—is preferred.
  
• Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders.

SolarWinds is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. SolarWinds will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

All applications are treated in accordance with the SolarWinds Privacy Notice: https://www.solarwinds.com/applicant-privacy-notice

jobs.description:
### Job Summary

What you need to know about the role- As an iOS Software Engineer, you will build and maintain the PayPal POS app that small businesses use every day to take payments, run checkout and manage their shop. You will work on features across the app experience, from first sign-in and bootstrap to checkout, receipts, refunds and invoices, and learn how it connects to card readers and Tap to Pay on iPhone.

Meet our team

Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned.

### Essential Responsibilities

* Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
* Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
* Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
* Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
* May contribute to code & design reviews

### Minimum Qualifications

* 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

### Your way to impact

* Make checkout and receipts fast and reliable for merchants who depend on the app at the counter.
* Deliver features across product library, inventory, purchase history, refunds and invoices.
* Help legacy Zettle merchants move onto PayPal identity with a smooth sign-in and onboarding experience in the app.
* Improve app stability, release quality and crash-free sessions.

### Your day to day

* Build and ship features in Swift using modern concurrency; UIKit and SwiftUI as the product requires.
* Integrate with backend services over REST and GraphQL; handle auth and session flows.
* Work with Bluetooth reader connectivity (Core Bluetooth) and Apple payment frameworks under guidance.
* Write unit and UI tests, and take part in code reviews, CI/CD and staged releases.
* Investigate crashes and production issues using analytics and monitoring and fix root causes.
* Pair with Sweden engineers and write documentation and runbooks for areas you take over.

### What do you need to bring

* 1 to 3 years of iOS development experience with strong Swift.
* Hands-on with SwiftUI and/or UIKit, networking, local persistence and concurrency.
* Experience with unit and UI testing and CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps.
* Understanding of secure handling of sensitive data on device.
* Interest in payments; experience with in-app payments, Bluetooth peripherals or NFC is a plus.
* Nice to have: Objective-C, GraphQL clients, Apple Tap to Pay on iPhone.
* Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden.
* A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records.
* Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product.
